# Royal Effect Studios

> Royal Effect Studios is a premium brand identity and logo design studio based in Lagos, Nigeria. We build strategic, modern brands for ambitious founders and businesses across Africa and globally.

## What We Do

We specialize in brand identity design — logos, visual systems, typography, color, and brand guidelines. We don't do generic. Every engagement is bespoke, category-defining, and built from scratch with zero middle management.

Our services include:
- Brand strategy and positioning
- Logo design and visual identity systems
- Typography and color system development
- Brand guidelines and documentation
- Applied brand assets for print and digital
- Ongoing brand support and retainers

## Who We Work With

We work with ambitious founders, startups, and established businesses across industries — hospitality, consumer products, technology, and professional services. We are based in Lagos, Nigeria, and work with clients globally across all time zones.
